subject: Re: Helios Health — request to compress demo / adjust timing
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna.patel@helioshealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Carlson <ben.carlson@helioshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: compress demo / move due to exec calendar

Hi Markus / Karthik,

Thanks again for scheduling the demo for next week. We have a late change on our side — the execs we wanted in the room now have a conflict: a regulatory review was moved into that timing window and they can only join for the last 30 minutes of the slot.

Two asks from our side:
- Can the demo be compressed to a focused 30-minute run (exec-level highlight + Q&A) instead of the full 60?
- If we need to move, can we shift to any time on Thurs (Sep 23) morning PT or Fri (Sep 24) early PT? Attached is an .ics with our updated availability.

We realize this is last-minute — happy to reassign a backup SE if your original SE is not available due to travel.

Attendees (likely): Ben Carlson (Platform), Anna Patel (Director of Platform), plus 1-2 product managers.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this is an important meeting for our shortlist decision.

Best,
Anna

--
Anna Patel
Director of Platform | Helios Health
anna.patel@helioshealth.com
[Attachment: helio-availability.ics]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helios Health — request to compress demo / adjust timing

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for the .ics. Totally understand the exec constraint.

We can definitely run a tighter 30-minute exec-focused session. Two quick options:
- Option A: Thu 2026-09-23 09:00–09:30 PT (we'll keep it high-level, demo the routing/cost controls and the canary fallback flow)
- Option B: Fri 2026-09-24 08:30–09:00 PT

If neither works, we can keep the original date and split: 30 minutes with execs now + follow-up deep dive with the product team later.

Note: I have travel that afternoon and might not be able to lead a later reschedule. Grace O'Connor (cc'd) is available and can lead the 30-min exec session if we need to reassign. Grace — can you confirm availability for Option A/B?

I'll also attach a one-slide executive deck and the 30-minute agenda for clarity.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

> I have travel that afternoon and might not be able to lead a later reschedule. Grace O'Connor (cc'd) is available and can lead the 30-min exec session if we need to reassign.

Thanks Markus — wanted to confirm: Markus is on-site that day for an enterprise POC and is double-booked between 12:30–17:00 PT; best to move forward with Grace as the lead to avoid any last-minute handoffs. Grace — if you can take Option A (Thu 09:00–09:30 PT) that would be ideal.

Anna — if Option A works, we'll send an updated calendar invite and a tighter 30-minute agenda focused on:
1) Outcomes you expect from the shortlist call
2) Key integration questions (data residency / VPC options)
3) High-level latency/cost tradeoffs and a single follow-up action for a 60-minute technical deep dive if needed

If you prefer the Fri slot, let me know and we'll adapt.

Thanks — Karthik

Option A (Thu 09:00–09:30 PT) works for us. Thanks for offering the compressed format and for reassigning Grace to lead — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Attendees: Anna Patel, Ben Carlson, Sarah Lim (PM, will dial in), possibly Raj (security lead) — Raj may only make the first 10 minutes.

Please send the updated invite and the one-slide exec deck. We'll treat the 30-min session as the decision checkpoint; if we need more technical detail we'll schedule the 60-min deep dive next week.

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
